title: IEEE Report Highlights How Members Are Engineering for Public Good
caption:
When catastrophic hurricanes knock out regional cell networks, specialized mobile tech vehicles step in to keep first responders and survivors connected. IEEE's latest social impact report reveals how humanitarian engineering programs are deploying critical hardware to disaster zones worldwide.

Source: Spectrum - IEEE Report Highlights How Members Are Engineering for Public Good

https://spectrum.ieee.org/ieee-report-engineering-public-good
